name: Floor One: Dynamic Homecoming
notes: Tables are GM prompts, not automatic new mechanics.
Public crawler seeds intentionally exclude private intake and sensitive material.

results.title: PARADE DETOUR
results.text: A homecoming float blocks the street. Its papier-mâché mascot turns its head only when nobody is looking.
results.gm: Offer a detour, investigation, or a Weak complication. If ignored, mark the route as increasingly unstable.

results.title: WRONG ADDRESS
results.text: A mailbox bears a crawler's surname at an address that should not exist.
results.gm: Harmless memory bleed. Searching reveals an anomaly clue; do not introduce private/off-limits material.

results.title: PEP RALLY OF ONE
results.text: A lone NPC cheerleader performs to an empty intersection and refuses to acknowledge the empty crowd.
results.gm: Social clue. Successful engagement points toward the school or stadium.

results.title: ROADWORK
results.text: Orange barrels create a route that was open ten minutes ago.
results.gm: Redirect the party toward an unused location or encounter without hard-locking them.

results.title: GARAGE SALE
results.text: A suburban lawn is covered in low-value Misc. Junk with absurd price tags.
results.gm: Mostly flavor and scavenging. Do not substitute this for a loot-box reward.

results.title: SIREN TEST
results.text: The town siren sounds. Every NPC freezes for exactly six seconds.
results.gm: Escalation clue. At State 2+, a Mob patrol changes direction toward the party.

results.title: LOST DOG POSTER
results.text: Every utility pole suddenly carries the same missing-dog poster.
results.gm: Foreshadow Home, Sweet Home? or Cerberuff without forcing the quest.

results.title: FRIDAY TRAFFIC
results.text: Cars with no drivers idle at a four-way stop, each politely waiting forever.
results.gm: Environmental puzzle or cover. Vehicles are scenery unless GM explicitly enables them.

results.title: TAILGATE
results.text: An immaculate tailgate party appears behind a closed business.
results.gm: NPC scene; food is suspicious but not automatically harmful.

results.title: POWER FLICKER
results.text: The whole block loses power except one building.
results.gm: Spotlight an optional location or clue.

results.title: MARCHING BAND
results.text: A marching band crosses an alley too narrow to contain it.
results.gm: Pure System weirdness unless the GM wants a Moderate complication.

results.title: EMPTY BUS
results.text: A school bus stops, opens its doors, and displays the party's current destination.
results.gm: The bus can shorten travel at the price of advancing the escalation meter by one scene.

results.title: SPONSOR BREAK
results.text: The System pauses local ambience for an aggressively cheerful fake sponsor message.
results.gm: Use as pacing relief; no mechanical effect.

results.title: PERFORMANCE REVIEW
results.text: The System publicly summarizes one harmless party habit in the least flattering way possible.
results.gm: Target table behavior only; never reveal private intake data.

results.title: SAFETY REMINDER
results.text: The System announces a safety tip immediately after making the environment less safe.
results.gm: Introduce a minor environmental complication.

results.title: AUDIENCE POLL
results.text: The System claims viewers voted on what happens next.
results.gm: GM chooses between two prepared complications; no actual external vote is required.

results.title: LOCAL COLOR
results.text: The System attempts a Texas saying and gets it subtly wrong.
results.gm: Flavor; an NPC may react as another clue the town is fabricated.

results.title: PATCH NOTES
results.text: The System announces that a nearby feature has been 'fixed.'
results.gm: Change one harmless environmental detail in plain sight.

results.title: ACHIEVEMENT TEASE
results.text: The System says someone is one action away from an achievement but refuses to say who or what.
results.gm: Use to encourage experimentation, not to force behavior.

results.title: WEATHER UPDATE
results.text: The System predicts weather that exists only inside one building.
results.gm: Point toward an optional location.

results.title: PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT
results.text: The System reminds crawlers that dying remains discouraged but permitted.
results.gm: Flavor or pre-combat beat.

results.title: QUALITY ASSURANCE
results.text: A floating error message appears over an NPC for three seconds.
results.gm: The NPC is a memory reconstruction clue, not automatically hostile.

results.title: TERMS UPDATED
results.text: The System announces updated terms nobody can read.
results.gm: Escalation flavor.

results.title: COMMERCIAL BREAK
results.text: The System gives the party ten seconds of suspicious silence.
results.gm: At State 3+, use the silence to reposition a patrol or reveal a new route.

results.title: LOOPING BLOCK
results.text: The next intersection repeats once before allowing passage.
results.gm: Investigation can reveal a seam in the reconstruction.

results.title: BACKWARDS CLOCK
results.text: Every visible clock runs backward for one minute.
results.gm: No mechanical penalty; anomaly clue.

results.title: WRONG SKY
results.text: A rectangular patch of sky shows sunset while the rest is midday.
results.gm: Visible memory/rendering fault.

results.title: DUPLICATE HOUSE
results.text: Two identical houses occupy adjacent lots, including identical occupants.
results.gm: Talking to both versions can reveal contradictory memories.

results.title: SIGN ERROR
results.text: A street sign briefly displays a location from another part of town.
results.gm: Foreshadow a future route.

results.title: TEXTURE POP
results.text: A brick wall becomes flat gray for a heartbeat.
results.gm: Pure clue unless touched during the glitch.

results.title: MISSING SOUND
results.text: Footsteps stop making noise on one stretch of sidewalk.
results.gm: Temporary environmental advantage or unease at GM discretion.

results.title: INFINITE AISLE
results.text: A convenience-store aisle extends far beyond the building.
results.gm: Optional exploration pocket; return path remains available.

results.title: SHADOW DELAY
results.text: Shadows move a second after their owners.
results.gm: Escalation clue.

results.title: RAIN LINE
results.text: Rain falls on exactly one side of the street.
results.gm: No damage; strong visual anomaly.

results.title: COPY-PASTE NPC
results.text: Three pedestrians share the same face and outfit.
results.gm: Social clue; they repeat different fragments of the same sentence.

results.title: LOADING DOOR
results.text: A door shows a spinning loading icon instead of opening.
results.gm: At State 2+, it may become a shortcut after another clue is found.

results.title: FAMILIAR OBJECT
results.text: A harmless object appears that one crawler recognizes from ordinary life.
results.gm: Ask the player for a safe mundane detail if useful; never invent sensitive history.

results.title: WRONG SONG
results.text: A tune sounds familiar but has incorrect lyrics.
results.gm: Player may supply what feels familiar; no private-data assumption.

results.title: SCHOOL PHOTO
results.text: A group photo contains one crawler in the background where they do not belong.
results.gm: Clue that the System is compositing memories.

results.title: OLD RECEIPT
results.text: A receipt lists a mundane purchase and a date that makes no sense.
results.gm: Counts as anomaly evidence if the party keeps it.

results.title: FAMILIAR SMELL
results.text: A location smells strongly of a safe familiar place.
results.gm: Use sensory detail only; let the player define it.

results.title: VOICE MAIL
results.text: A dead phone plays a generic message in a familiar cadence.
results.gm: Do not imitate or name real relatives without player invitation.

results.title: ROOM LAYOUT
results.text: A room uses the layout of somewhere familiar but the exterior does not match.
results.gm: Investigation clue.

results.title: MISSING DETAIL
results.text: A crawler knows something should be present, but the reconstruction omitted it.
results.gm: Reward player-authored mundane detail with an anomaly clue.

results.title: COMPOSITE MEMORY
results.text: Two unrelated places have been stitched together.
results.gm: Strong clue toward the Homecoming reconstruction mystery.

results.title: NAME SWAP
results.text: An NPC uses the right first name with the wrong face.
results.gm: Keep identities fictional unless player volunteers otherwise.

results.title: OBJECT RESET
results.text: A moved mundane object snaps back to its original position.
results.gm: Can be exploited to test the simulation.

results.title: MEMORY ECHO
results.text: The party hears a harmless phrase one crawler remembers saying before entering.
results.gm: Let the player author the phrase; otherwise use generic chatter.

results.title: UTILITY CACHE
results.text: A maintenance cabinet contains rope, tape, basic tools, or other mundane utility gear.
results.gm: Mundane discovery; not a loot box.

results.title: FIRST AID STATION
results.text: A picked-over first-aid cabinet contains basic supplies.
results.gm: Keep rewards modest unless tied to an achievement/quest.

results.title: LOST AND FOUND
results.text: A bin contains odd clothing and Misc. Junk.
results.gm: Mostly flavor; one item can become a future crafting prop.

results.title: VENDING ERROR
results.text: A machine dispenses a mundane item instead of food.
results.gm: Comedic utility item.

results.title: SPORTS CLOSET
results.text: A storage room contains basic athletic equipment.
results.gm: Potential improvised weapons/tools; quality remains mundane.

results.title: JANITOR CART
results.text: Cleaning supplies create environmental options.
results.gm: Do not silently create new RAW chemical mechanics.

results.title: PROPERTY TAG
results.text: A tagged object points toward Brown County Lockup.
results.gm: Clue plus mundane object.

results.title: PRO SHOP SAMPLE
results.text: A promotional item points toward Memory Lanes.
results.gm: Clue plus mundane gear.

results.title: RANGE FREEBIE
results.text: Eye/ear protection or a utility sling points toward Last Stand.
results.gm: No automatic firearm reward.

results.title: PARADE SUPPLY
results.text: Zip ties, cord, paint, and signage sit behind a float.
results.gm: Improvisation materials.

results.title: LOCKER STASH
results.text: A school locker contains a mundane personal kit and an anomaly note.
results.gm: Clue, not high-tier loot.

results.title: SYSTEM COUPON
results.text: A digital coupon promises a loot box only if a real achievement condition is met.
results.gm: Create/choose an achievement rather than handing out the box directly.

results.title: OVERHELPFUL
results.text: NPC gives too many directions and accidentally contradicts themselves.
results.gm: Contradiction is a clue.

results.title: DEFENSIVE
results.text: NPC insists everything is normal before anyone asks.
results.gm: Social anomaly.

results.title: STARSTRUCK
results.text: NPC treats a crawler like a local celebrity for no explained reason.
results.gm: System/audience weirdness; no mechanical bonus by default.

results.title: SCRIPTED
results.text: NPC repeats the same sentence after any unrelated question.
results.gm: Clear reconstruction clue.

results.title: BARGAINING
results.text: NPC wants a harmless favor before sharing information.
results.gm: Create a short scene, not necessarily a formal Quest.

results.title: AVOIDANT
results.text: NPC changes the subject whenever the stadium is mentioned.
results.gm: Points toward escalation mystery.

results.title: MISTAKEN IDENTITY
results.text: NPC confidently calls a crawler by the wrong name.
results.gm: Memory-composite clue.

results.title: HOSTILE POLITE
results.text: NPC is threatening while maintaining exaggerated customer-service manners.
results.gm: Can become social or combat complication.

results.title: GLITCH PANIC
results.text: NPC notices their own repeated line and briefly panics.
results.gm: Humanizing clue; they may become an ally.

results.title: LOCAL GOSSIP
results.text: NPC shares one true clue and one obviously ridiculous rumor.
results.gm: GM decides which clue advances current route.

results.title: SYSTEM LOYALIST
results.text: NPC praises the Dungeon System like a civic institution.
results.gm: May report disruptive behavior at State 2+.

results.title: EXHAUSTED
results.text: NPC quietly asks the party to stop making the town change.
results.gm: Foreshadows escalation states.

results.title: REINFORCEMENTS?
results.text: A second group is heard approaching but may be friend, foe, or nothing.
results.gm: Use RAW guidance that reinforcements can alter encounter numbers; avoid accidental Overwhelming scaling.

results.title: BAD FOOTING
results.text: Part of the battlefield becomes awkward terrain or obstructed.
results.gm: Adjudicate with existing RAW checks; do not invent a permanent condition.

results.title: LOST WEAPON
results.text: A Mob tries to grab a dropped/accessible weapon and flee.
results.gm: Core guidance explicitly supports a Mob stealing a fallen crawler's weapon as a complication.

results.title: CIVILIAN CROSSING
results.text: An NPC wanders through the fight at the worst time.
results.gm: Creates choice without changing Mob stats.

results.title: LIGHTS OUT
results.text: Lighting fails for one beat.
results.gm: Use narrative positioning; apply a mechanical modifier only if supported by an existing rule.

results.title: SYSTEM TAUNT
results.text: The System announces an embarrassing combat statistic.
results.gm: Flavor; may foreshadow an achievement.

results.title: OBJECTIVE MOVES
results.text: The thing being protected/retrieved changes position.
results.gm: Keep victory condition achievable.

results.title: DOOR LOCKS
results.text: An exit closes until a visible local control is used.
results.gm: Never trap crawlers in a stairwell room with a trap.

results.title: MOB PANIC
results.text: One ordinary Mob tries to flee when allies fall.
results.gm: Can shorten combat or create chase.

results.title: THIRD PARTY
results.text: Another Mob faction briefly enters the area.
results.gm: Use sparingly and scale total active threats.

results.title: ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARD
results.text: A harmless-looking prop becomes dangerous.
results.gm: Signal the hazard before serious damage.

results.title: AUDIENCE FAVOR
results.text: The System theatrically highlights a risky opportunity.
results.gm: Optional stunt; reward creativity rather than forcing it.

results.title: TOO QUIET
results.text: Nothing attacks; the lack of ambient noise becomes conspicuous.
results.gm: Rest proceeds unless another rule prevents it.

results.title: NOSY NPC
results.text: An NPC wants conversation, gossip, or reassurance.
results.gm: Roleplay interruption only.

results.title: PATROL ROUTE
results.text: A distant patrol passes nearby.
results.gm: Party may hide, relocate, or allow the scene to develop.

results.title: SYSTEM CHECK-IN
results.text: The System asks whether everyone is enjoying their break.
results.gm: Flavor; can tease an achievement.

results.title: ROOM RESET
results.text: Small objects reset while the party watches.
results.gm: Anomaly clue.

results.title: BAD TV
results.text: A television shows a delayed feed of the room.
results.gm: Strong reconstruction clue.

results.title: FALSE ALARM
results.text: A threatening sound resolves into something mundane.
results.gm: Pacing tool.

results.title: NEIGHBOR COMPLAINT
results.text: An NPC complains about noise as if this were normal suburbia.
results.gm: Dark comedy.

results.title: SUPPLY OPPORTUNITY
results.text: A mundane utility cache is noticed during downtime.
results.gm: No automatic loot box.

results.title: MEMORY DREAM
results.text: A resting crawler gets a harmless, surreal memory echo.
results.gm: Player may author safe details; no forced personal revelation.

results.title: LOCKDOWN WARNING
results.text: The System announces a future route closure.
results.gm: At State 3+, make the warning real after the rest.

results.title: UNINTERRUPTED
results.text: Against all expectations, the rest is uneventful.
results.gm: Use this result! Not every table roll should punish resting.

results.title: NOISY SUCCESS
results.text: They fail quietly enough to avoid catastrophe but attract attention.
results.gm: Advance a patrol or future complication.

results.title: LOST TIME
results.text: The attempt costs meaningful time.
results.gm: Advance scene/escalation clock rather than dealing arbitrary damage.

results.title: PARTIAL CLUE
results.text: They learn something useful but incomplete.
results.gm: Point toward another location or NPC.

results.title: RESOURCE COST
results.text: A mundane tool breaks or supply is consumed.
results.gm: Use only a resource actually present.

results.title: BAD POSITION
results.text: They end up somewhere inconvenient but not trapped.
results.gm: Offer a clear route forward.

results.title: SYSTEM NOTICES
results.text: The System comments on the failure and tags the behavior for a possible achievement.
results.gm: No immediate mechanical penalty required.

results.title: NPC DISTRUST
results.text: An NPC becomes less cooperative.
results.gm: Can be repaired through later action.

results.title: WRONG ANSWER
results.text: They receive believable but contradictory information.
results.gm: Make the contradiction discoverable.

results.title: COMPLICATION
results.text: Success is possible, but a new problem enters the scene.
results.gm: Classic fail-forward result.

results.title: CHOICE
results.text: Offer two costs and let the party choose.
results.gm: Keep both costs proportionate.

results.title: ESCALATION
results.text: Increase Homecoming escalation by one scene/step if fiction supports it.
results.gm: Do not skip mandatory clues.

results.title: SECOND CHANCE
results.text: The failure reveals how to try again differently.
results.gm: Avoid dead-end investigation.

results.title: PUMP SEVEN
results.text: People say the gas station closes at the same time every night, even when the clocks disagree.
results.gm: Points toward Pump Seven.

results.title: LOCKER 113
results.text: Someone swears Locker 113 was removed years ago.
results.gm: Points toward the school anomaly.

results.title: IMPOSSIBLE RECEIPTS
results.text: Shoppers have receipts for stores that do not exist.
results.gm: Points toward the retail anomaly quest.

results.title: BLACK DOOR
results.text: A delivery driver refuses to use an alley because of a door that 'wasn't there yesterday.'
results.gm: Points toward the Black Door chain.

results.title: STADIUM LIGHTS
results.text: The stadium lights switch on even when the grid is down.
results.gm: Points toward the late-floor stadium escalation.

results.title: MISSING PARTY
results.text: An NPC remembers seeing another crawler group, but every detail changes on retelling.
results.gm: Points toward Nadia/missing-party content.

results.title: COLISEUM
results.text: People whisper about an arena where the crowd arrives before the fighters.
results.gm: Points toward The Coliseum.

results.title: LOCKUP
results.text: Confiscated property at the county lockup includes things that should not exist here.
results.gm: Points toward Brown County Lockup.

results.title: GOOD BOY
results.text: Neighbors disagree on whether the same dog has one head or three.
results.gm: Points toward Home, Sweet Home?.

results.title: PERFECT GAME
results.text: The bowling alley scoreboard sometimes shows names before players arrive.
results.gm: Points toward Memory Lanes.

results.title: LAST STAND
results.text: The gun shop has plenty of attitude and strangely little useful ammunition.
results.gm: Points toward Last Stand without promising firearm upgrades.

results.title: THE MAP
results.text: Someone claims Bosses always know the neighborhood better than crawlers do.
results.gm: Foreshadows RAW boss map rewards without granting one early.

escalation_states.name: HOMECOMING
escalation_states.summary: The false Brownwood mostly behaves. Weirdness is deniable.
escalation_states.unlock: Street encounters, rumors, light memory bleed.
escalation_states.gm: Keep anomalies small and let the players choose their first threads.

escalation_states.name: SOMETHING'S WRONG
escalation_states.summary: Contradictions accumulate. The reconstruction starts showing seams.
escalation_states.unlock: Environmental Weirdness and stronger Memory Bleed become common.
escalation_states.gm: Use repeated details and impossible geography. Do not force a single investigation path.

escalation_states.name: THE SYSTEM NOTICES
escalation_states.summary: The System reacts directly to the party's investigation.
escalation_states.unlock: System Interruptions can target current behavior; patrols can redirect toward the party.
escalation_states.gm: Make the town feel responsive, not omniscient. Player choices should still create openings.

escalation_states.name: LOCKDOWN
escalation_states.summary: Routes shift, Black Door activity rises, and stronger opposition appears.
escalation_states.unlock: Route closures, stronger encounter variants, Black Door chain.
escalation_states.gm: Telegraph closures and always leave at least one actionable route. Avoid accidental Overwhelming fights.

escalation_states.name: FRIDAY NIGHT FOREVER
escalation_states.summary: The stadium becomes the gravitational center of Floor One.
escalation_states.unlock: Stadium finale, Home Side Advantage, route toward the next descent.
escalation_states.gm: Pay off prior clues and recurring jokes. The floor should feel transformed by what the party uncovered.

hooks: Reward reckless curiosity with attention, not automatic success.
Offer achievements for provoking obviously bad ideas that somehow reveal useful information.
crawler_seeds.running_joke: The System keeps pretending Harold is an unpaid quality-assurance tester.

hooks: Let genre awareness identify patterns without making him automatically correct.
Occasionally make the obvious horror trope the safe option just to be rude.
crawler_seeds.running_joke: The System critiques Marvin's horror literacy like a disappointed film professor.

hooks: Present impossible details that invite interpretation without confirming a supernatural explanation outside the Dungeon.
Let conviction create social moments with reconstructed NPCs.
crawler_seeds.running_joke: The System keeps offering extremely unhelpful 'signs.'

hooks: Give pattern, map, and contradiction puzzles that reward careful synthesis.
Let over-analysis occasionally uncover a second, stranger layer.
crawler_seeds.running_joke: The System grades explanations nobody asked for.

hooks: Notice disciplined positioning and deliberate refusal to default to firearms.
Use the Pool Cue reward line as a recurring independence theme.
crawler_seeds.running_joke: The System tracks how many perfectly serviceable guns Jarod has declined to solve problems with.

hooks: Reward repair, improvisation, and practical workarounds.
Offer broken systems that can be made useful rather than simply bypassed.
crawler_seeds.running_joke: The System files every successful repair as an unauthorized warranty claim.
